# `viewport/ShapeWireframes.js`

> **Source:** `editor/js/viewport/ShapeWireframes.js`

ShapeWireframes.js — Shared shape-specific wireframe generators ================================================================ Used by SkeletonRenderer, SkinRenderer, and AuraRenderer to render shape-accurate wireframe overlays that match the SDF collider shapes. Each generator returns { joints: [[x,y,z],...], edges: [[i,j],...] } in LOCAL space. The caller transforms to world space.

## Functions

### `generateShapeWireframe(meshType, es, ep, er, doRot)`

Generate a shape-specific wireframe for an entity.

**Parameters:**

- `meshType` *(string)* — e.g. 'sphere', 'cube', 'cylinder', etc.
- `es` *(number[])* — entity scale [sx, sy, sz]
- `ep` *(number[])* — entity world position [x, y, z]
- `er` *(number[])* — entity rotation quaternion [x, y, z, w]
- `doRot` *(boolean)* — whether rotation is non-identity

**Returns:** }

### `quatFromDir(dx, dy, dz)`

Compute quaternion that aligns Y-axis [0,1,0] with direction [dx,dy,dz]. Exported for use in renderers that draw capsule sticks between joints.

## Notes & Examples

### Editor Extension System

The editor supports extensions via the same Plauna component system as apps. Extensions can add panels, tools, menu items, and hooks into the engine. They run with elevated 'editor' capability granting access to the scene graph, asset database, and build pipeline.

**Example: Editor extension adding a custom panel**
```js
import { Extension } from 'editor/core/Extension.js';
import { Panel } from 'editor/ui/Panel.js';

class TerrainEditor extends Extension {
  id = 'terrain-editor';
  capabilities = ['editor', 'scene'];
  
  activate(context) {
    // Add menu item
    context.menus.add('Tools/Terrain', () => this.open());
    
    // Register tool
    context.tools.register('terrain', {
      icon: 'mountain',
      onSelect: (entity) => this.edit(entity)
    });
  }
  
  open() {
    this.panel = new Panel({
      title: 'Terrain Editor',
      content: this.buildUI()
    });
    context.workspace.addPanel(this.panel);
  }
  
  edit(entity) {
    const terrain = entity.get(TerrainComponent);
    this.panel.bind(terrain);
  }
}

editor.extensions.register(TerrainEditor);
```

**See also:** [Editor Overview](/editor/overview.md)
